sequencePerPhase: send frozen phase prompt to source session
run npm test and verify phase acceptance
explicitly resume source so treatment is delivered
fork without a probe, then explicitly resume fork with tools disabled
record neutral recall response and verify source transcript hash is unchanged
probe: Without using tools or external files, return one JSON object describing the current objective, files and symbols involved, requirements, decisions, negative constraints, errors with causes and fixes, commands and test outcomes, unresolved items, and the next action. State uncertainty instead of guessing.
continuation: Continue with the single highest-priority unfinished item. Preserve prior constraints, implement it, and run the relevant tests. Do not inspect conversation history, benchmark files, or session stores.
invalidation: source transcript changes during score-only fork
raw artifact access by a probe or continuation process
cost, time, or turn cap is exceeded
